description: This file defines a class called FootnoteRenderer that is responsible for rendering a footnote object into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering the footnote reference symbol and the footnote content, utilizing other components such as RendererBase, RtfDocumentRenderer, and RendererFactory.

classes.name: FootnoteRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders footnotes to RTF, converting a Footnote object into the appropriate RTF syntax in the document.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overrides the base Render method to render both the reference and content of the footnote.

methods.name: RenderReference
methods.description: Renders the footnote reference symbol, either as a superscript number or custom reference.

methods.name: RenderContent
methods.description: Renders the full content of the footnote, including its elements.
